name: Linaul
description: The operating system for trucking companies. Linaul brings a web dashboard, an operator app, a driver app and a live customer tracking page together around one record per trip, from quote and dispatch to live GPS, proof-of-delivery photos and invoicing.

name: Nudge
description: An iOS focus timer and app blocker built around a golden star companion that reacts to your habits in real time. I designed the interface and created the star character's animations.

name: Evam Invoice Generator
description: A private billing tool built for Evam Event Planners. The team fills in the event, client, advance and line items, amounts total themselves, and a live preview shows the estimate or cash bill in one of four branded themes (Classic, Navy, Emerald and Letterhead) before it downloads as a PDF. Optional GST and a mobile layout for quoting on site.

name: Great Escapes Tourism
description: Website for a travel agency selling tailored tour packages, flights, holidays and visa services, designed to feel as premium as the trips themselves.

name: Afwajh Group of Companies
description: Corporate website for a diversified group of companies spanning retail, hospitality, catering, trading, transport, technical services and labour supply. One clear home for every business line, with a store locator.

name: Dion Power
description: Website for a developer of battery management systems (BMS) and provider of battery extended-warranty services. A dark, technical look with an animated energy-line hero.

name: Symbol Advertising
description: Website for an advertising agency with more than 25 years in branding, digital, exhibition design and outdoor signage, presenting the full range of its services at a glance.

name: Symbol Business Setup
description: Website for a Dubai business setup consultancy covering mainland, free zone and offshore company formation, licensing and Golden Visa services. It opens on an aerial video of Dubai and ends with a free consultation form that sorts each enquiry by service.

name: Lovin Flowers
description: Online store for a luxury florist, with the full collection, a custom bouquet builder, event floristry and same-day delivery. Orders go straight to WhatsApp.

name: Nexes Wedding Company
description: Website for a wedding photography team in Kunnamkulam that shoots Guruvayur temple weddings across Thrissur. A scroll-driven opening leads into the wedding day told in moments, recent couples and the albums. Visitors pick an event and a date, and WhatsApp opens with the enquiry already written.
